Maria_CS: @channel quick check — onboarding for Harborly hit our latency SLO last week. Customer wants an evidence bundle for the renewal call. Can we collate uptime + p95 latency + any incident notes? :wave:
Sam Ops: On it. Do we need full 30 days or just the onboarding window (last 7 days)?
Maria_CS: They asked for onboarding window + a 30d trend. Renewal is in 2 weeks so keep it concise.
Erin SRE: I can pull uptime from the uptime-dashboard and p95 from traces. Sharing the quick query for p95:
```
# Influx/metrics query (example)
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95) FROM request_metrics WHERE customer_id='harborly' AND time >= now() - 7d
```
Erin SRE: Also found a transient deploy rollback on 3300123020 — root cause was model config mismatch, had a 3m spike. Not user-facing after fallback.
Jason Account: We should proactively offer a one-time onboarding credit if they flag any SLA misses. What's the credit calc again? Is it % of monthly bill?
Sam Ops: Policy: credit = min(10% monthly, pro-rated for downtime). I'll draft calc; need the exact downtime window.
Maria_CS: Jason — if you want to offer credits, keep it conditional pending evidence. I'll prep an email template for customers.
Erin SRE: Uploading artifacts now: uptime-snapshot.png, p95-table.csv, incident-notes.md
EngDeployBot: [deploy] rollout completed for model-quant-v2 to prod at 3300123000 :white_check_mark:
Sam Ops: Thanks Erin. Maria — can you review the draft summary by EOD? I'll assemble the bundle for Legal/Sales.
Maria_CS: Yes. I'll add a one-paragraph impact summary and the recommended credit language. Then we can send to Harborly's CSM and schedule the renewal prep call. :thumbsup:
